gameDescriptionHtml:
Fight alongside your companions and venture deeper
Throughout your journey, you will meet a cast of distinctive companions and venture deeper together.

New regions will open, new allies will join your party, and new storylines will unfold.

With every step forward, you draw closer to their pasts—and to the hidden side of this world.

Not your usual “move once, attack once” tactics game
Each character has a rich and versatile skill set, letting you freely plan an entire turn around your resources and chain multiple abilities together.

When your three party members link their actions together, a single battle becomes a layered, coordinated offensive of your own making.

Knockbacks, collisions, terrain, and objects are all weapons
Height, cover, displacement, knockbacks, collisions, and battlefield objects and terrain all have a real impact on combat.

Slam enemies into obstacles, trigger chain reactions through objects, and use terrain to reshape both offense and defense.

Even a seemingly limited battlefield can keep opening up new tactical solutions.

Repeated ventures shape each character’s combat style
As you push deeper, your characters continue to grow in new directions.

Skill Insights can change how abilities function, while talents, equipment, gems, and other upgrades can push the same character toward completely different builds and playstyles.

Echoes open the path, memories reveal the truth
Defeat powerful enemies and obtain precious Echoes to advance the story and unlock deeper regions.

But that is only the beginning.

Keep venturing deeper and collect Chapter Memory Fragments to uncover each character’s hidden past—and the deeper secrets of the world itself.
